email.factice: The domain {domaine} does not receive mail. Please enter an address you actually read.
email.invalide: This e-mail address is incomplete. Example: first.last@gmail.com
email.aCorriger: Pick the suggested correction, or confirm your address is correct.

canal.sansEmail: I don’t have an e-mail address
canal.sansEmailAide: We will send you a verification code on WhatsApp instead.
canal.whatsappAide: Ivorian mobile number (01, 05 or 07), for example +225 07 07 12 12 34. You will receive a code on WhatsApp.

verification.texteEmail: Your request has been sent to the school. To confirm that {destination} is your address, enter the 6-digit code we just sent there: the school will know it can write to you.
verification.texteTelephone: Your request has been sent to the school. To confirm that {destination} is your WhatsApp number, enter the 6-digit code we just sent there: the school will know it can reach you.
verification.codeAide: Six digits. You can also click the link you received.
verification.renvoye: A new code has just been sent.
verification.renvoiImpossible: The code could not be resent. Please try again shortly.
verification.spam: Nothing received? Check your Spam or Junk folder, then resend the code.
verification.spamTelephone: Nothing received? Make sure this number uses WhatsApp, then resend the code.

motifs.code_invalide: This code does not match. Check the 6 digits you received.
motifs.expire: This code has expired. Request a new one.
motifs.trop_de_tentatives: Too many wrong codes. Request a new code.
motifs.inconnu: Verification failed. Please try again shortly.

page.succesTexte: Your e-mail address is confirmed: the school knows it can write to you. Your request had already been sent. You can close this page.
page.expireTexte: For security reasons, a verification link is only valid for a short time. Request a new link.
page.erreurTexte: It is incomplete, already used or badly copied. Open the link from your e-mail again, or enter the code on the page where you made your request.
page.indisponibleTexte: We cannot reach the school right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
page.lienRenvoye: A new link has just been sent to you.
page.description: Confirm your e-mail address so the school knows it can write to you.
page.lienTropTot: A link was just sent. Please wait a minute before asking for another.

verification.renvoiTropTot: A code was just sent. Please wait a minute before asking for another.
verification.adresseIncorrecte: Wrong address? Contact your school: it keeps it up to date in your file.
verification.numeroIncorrect: Wrong number? Contact your school: it keeps it up to date in your file.

inverse.texte: Your request has been sent to the school. To confirm that {destination} is your number, send the prepared message to the school from WhatsApp: it already contains your code.
inverse.ouvrir: Open WhatsApp and send the code
inverse.etapes: WhatsApp opens with the message already written. Tap Send without changing it, then come back to this page.
inverse.autreTelephone: Use the phone whose number is {destination}: the message must come from that number.
inverse.lienRenouvele: A new link is ready. Open WhatsApp again.
inverse.indisponible: We cannot reach the school right now. Retrying…

canalAlternatif.ouvrirDepuisWhatsapp: Nothing on WhatsApp? Get the code by email
canalAlternatif.ouvrirAutreAdresse: Not my address any more? Get the code at another address
canalAlternatif.aideDepuisWhatsapp: Leave empty to use the address on your file. A new address is passed on to the school with your request.
canalAlternatif.aideAutreAdresse: The code goes there, and so will your notice. The school sees this address on your request.
canalAlternatif.indisponible: This change isn’t available for this school yet. Contact it: it will update your contact details.

erreurs.emailInvalide: This address can’t receive messages. Check it, for example firstname.lastname@gmail.com.
erreurs.canalIndisponible: Your file has no email address: enter the one you read.
erreurs.tropTot: Several codes have already been requested. Wait a little before trying again.

acces.texteEmail: To see your notice and choose your time slot, enter the 6-digit code we just sent to {destination}.
acces.texteTelephone: To see your notice and choose your time slot, enter the 6-digit code we just sent on WhatsApp to {destination}.
acces.injoignable: Your file has neither an email address nor a WhatsApp number to send you a code. Contact your school: it will update your contact details.
acces.indisponible: The code couldn’t be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
acces.expire: For your security, access to your notice has expired. Confirm again that it’s you.
